programs.title: Agent-Managed, Human-Governed: A Worker Introduction to DAOs
outcomes: Explain the 'agents operate; people govern' division of labor using Cancer DAO as the case
Map the six agent roles and five zones to familiar workplace structures
Practice drafting and debating a proposal that only humans vote on

sessions.activity: Guided walk-through of the Cancer DAO charter: mission, focus, reserved human-only actions; small-group matching game pairing each reserved action with why it stays human.
Learners read an Evidence Monitor summary draft, check it against sources, and mark where agent summaries need human verification.
Working groups refine a Proposal & Grant Drafter draft; hold a mock debate and final vote, mirroring human-reserved governance.final_vote.
Learners review Progress Tracker dashboards and discuss how measurable outcomes keep both agents and members accountable.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized pre/post quiz scores on DAO literacy and mock-vote participation tallies, contributed as aggregate counts with no names or employer identifiers.
programs.consent: Voluntary adult enrollment with a signed data-sharing opt-in; participants can decline contribution or request deletion of their records at any time.

programs.title: Lake Union Science Citizens: Cancer Research and Community Governance
outcomes: Describe what a cancer-research campus like Fred Hutch does and why research support matters
Identify the parts of a mission-driven DAO and which decisions stay with people
Simulate proposing and voting on a community research-support project

sessions.activity: Virtual visit to the Fred Hutch South Lake Union campus; learners compare an Evidence Monitor summary with a short article and practice spotting verified facts.
Students write a class 'mini-charter' for supporting cancer research, listing which tasks agents may do and which the class must vote on.
Teams draft a small research-support proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter as helper; class debates and holds a paper-ballot vote.
Students build a simple progress chart for their chosen project and present how outcomes will be measured.

programs.data_shared: Aggregate, anonymous class-level results: how many proposals were submitted and which outcome categories students chose; no individual student data is collected or shared.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent forms required for all activities and any data sharing; teachers collect media and participation permissions separately, and any aggregate sharing excludes names, work, or photos.

programs.title: Evidence-to-Action: Running Agent-Assisted Programs for Health Missions
outcomes: Adapt the Cancer DAO zone model (synthesis, proposal, operations, observatory) to an NGO program cycle
Use agent-drafted evidence summaries responsibly in advocacy and grant writing
Design human-governed decision checkpoints in an agent-assisted workflow

sessions.activity: Workshop on commissioning and quality-checking Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs for policy briefs.
Learners role-play Collaborator Scout and Task Router functions, designing a partner-mapping and working-group plan for a health campaign.
Teams turn a synthesis into a Proposal & Grant Drafter outline, then apply a human review checklist before mock enactment.
Participants define measurable outcomes for their own program and set up a Progress Tracker-style dashboard mock-up.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized workshop artifacts: template adoption notes and de-identified program-cycle maps, shared as examples to a common practice library.
programs.consent: Organizational memorandum plus individual opt-in for sharing artifacts; staff may anonymize or withhold materials, and no beneficiary or client data is ever shared.

programs.title: Mission, Charter, Accountability: Nonprofit Governance in an Agent-Managed World
programs.grade_or_level: Board and staff / nonprofit professional development
outcomes: Compare nonprofit fiduciary duties with DAO reserved-for-humans actions
Draft measurable charter outcomes with agent support
Establish oversight routines for agent-drafted proposals and grants

sessions.activity: Side-by-side mapping of board duties (budget approval, bylaw changes) onto Cancer DAO's human-reserved actions like treasury.transfer and charter.amend.
Board-simulation exercise: review a Proposal & Grant Drafter draft, amend it, and conduct a recorded human-only vote.
Design task-routing and working-group workflows that keep staff in control of coordination while agents handle routing drafts.
Learners request and evaluate an agent research summary for a real program question, documenting verification steps.
Participants build a measurable-outcomes scorecard and a review cadence linking it to board meetings.

programs.data_shared: De-identified governance templates and anonymized scorecard examples contributed to a shared nonprofit practice commons; no donor, client, or financial data included.
programs.consent: Board resolution authorizes participation; individual contributors opt in per artifact, all materials are scrubbed of identifying details, and any party may withdraw shared items on request.
